biography.plain_text: Christina Sørensen Lotter is a Danish businesswoman and ocean-conservation supporter raised in Britain. A daughter of security entrepreneur Jørgen Philip-Sørensen, she became an owner and director of Danish Yachts and served on Ecover’s board. Her international business interests later encompassed investment-portfolio leadership, alongside sustained work with the International SeaKeepers Society.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Danish Yachts, Christina Sørensen Lotter promoted carbon-fibre construction as a means of extending the Skagen shipyard’s capabilities. She and the company’s president presented designs that drew on its offshore wind-service craft, bringing commercial shipbuilding experience into the leisure market. She also highlighted the yard’s participation in a European network devoted to lightweight maritime design.

Her conservation work has involved building organisations as well as supporting research. SeaKeepers named her its first Baltic partner for the DISCOVERY programme in 2015. She subsequently supported the society’s British and South African chapters and helped establish an ambassador programme that recruits accomplished sailors for citizen science and research expeditions.
